newsitem.title: USA: N. Dakota okays $1.49 bln biennium budget.
newsitem.headline: N. Dakota okays $1.49 bln biennium budget.

text.p: North Dakota legislators on Friday afternoon wrapped work on a $1.49 billion general fund state budget for the two year period beginning on July 1, the state's director of fiscal management said.

The biennium budget represents an approximately $139 million increase over the previous two year period and includes a $44 million increase for elementary and secondary education funding and $56 million for water projects, according to Gov. Ed Schafer's office.
The budget also includes four building projects at state universities that will be partly or fully funded by the issuance of debt, said Sheila Peterson, North Dakota director of fiscal management.

A $6 million project at the University of North Dakota, a $10 million project at North Dakota State University and a $1.7 million renovation at the North Dakota State College of Science will be partly funded by issuance of bonds, Peterson said.

A $4 million renovation at Minot State University will be funded wholly by bonds, Peterson said. A $1.4 million remodeling of the state youth correctional center will also be funded wholly by bonds, she said.
